dialogues.text_a: Can you install a single-phase socket outlet?
dialogues.text_b: No, I can’t. But I can connect a light switch.

dialogues.text_a: Can Ruwan wire distribution boards safely?
dialogues.text_b: Of course, he can. He wires distribution boards every day. He’s an electrical trainee.

dialogues.text_a: When are you going to test the circuit continuity?
dialogues.text_b: I’m going to test it tomorrow morning.

dialogues.text_a: When is Ravi going to replace the damaged fuse?
dialogues.text_b: He might replace it this morning, or he might replace it this afternoon. He really doesn’t know.

dialogues.text_c: Pain in his arm? How did he get it?
dialogues.text_d: He pulled heavy cables through the conduit all day yesterday.

dialogues.text_a: Did you label the circuit breakers correctly yesterday afternoon?
dialogues.text_b: No, I didn’t. I was feeling too tired.

dialogues.text_a: Why did you switch off the main supply this morning?

dialogues.text_a: I bought a new insulated screwdriver yesterday.
dialogues.text_b: Really? But I liked your old screwdriver. It was safe.
dialogues.text_c: That’s true. But my new screwdriver is safer.

dialogues.text_a: Why are you checking the voltage right now?
dialogues.text_b: I’m checking the voltage now because I checked it yesterday, but the reading was wrong. I am going to work on this panel this afternoon, and I might finish it today.
I am upset because I have to reconnect the wiring. I always test the circuit before switching it on, but this morning I forgot, and it was a careless mistake.
I’m testing a socket with a test lamp.
dialogues.text_c: That’s unusual. Do you usually test sockets with a test lamp?
dialogues.text_d: No, I usually use a multimeter, but I am using a test lamp today.
dialogues.text_f: Because the multimeter is not working.

dialogues.text_a: Can you and Amal install the ceiling lights now?
dialogues.text_b: No, we can’t. We have to finish pulling the cables first.

activity_c.text: Today I want to talk about how you are handling safety equipment and procedures in the electrical workshop.
For example, the distribution-board inspection took longer than expected.
Yesterday the main breaker was weaker than usual, and I had to test the terminals twice.
I’m going to inspect the neutral bar and test the earth-leakage protector.
I must also record everything in the safety log, because the administration team needs clear reports.
What about the new digital multimeter?
Are you checking the PPE cabinet regularly?
I check it every evening, but yesterday I wasn’t able to finish the insulating-glove test.
What are you doing about equipment inventory?
Yes, we can keep printed electrical safety checklists.
